Convert, resize and compress images on your Mac, just by right-clicking them in Finder.

## Install in 1 minute

1. Download **Pixel-Press.zip** below (under **Assets**) and unzip it.
2. Double-click each of the three `.workflow` files and click **Install**. If one already exists, click **Replace**.
3. Turn them on: **System Settings → General → Login Items & Extensions → Extensions → Finder**.

Then right-click any image or folder → **Quick Actions**. The [user guide](https://github.com/sahilpatel9910/pixel-press/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md) covers everything else.

## What you get

- **Compress to Size…**: shows how big your images are, then makes each one smaller than 2 MB, 1 MB, 500 KB, 200 KB, 100 KB or any size you type
- **Convert & Resize…**: JPG, PNG, HEIC, PDF or TIFF, at the size you pick. Remembers your last choice
- **Convert to JPG**: one click, for iPhone photos
- New files are saved next to the originals. Originals are never changed or overwritten
- Works on whole folders, and a notification shows how much space you saved
- 100% on your Mac: no uploads, nothing extra to install
- Also a Claude Code plugin: ask *"get these photos under 500 KB"*

Requires macOS 12 or later.
